blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY — The captain of the ill-fated MV June Aster is alive and had contacted his employers as search and recovery operations continued aboard the vessel five days after the maritime tragedy, authorities said on Tuesday. The condition of June Aster captain Roel Sarmiento was confirmed after he reached out to Atienza Interisland Ferries Inc., the vessel’s operator, said Kristine Mechelle Ablaña, spokesperson for the Coron Emergency Operations Center (EOC), in a telephone interview on Tuesday morning. However, authorities have yet to explain why the captain only made contact five days after the sea tragedy that killed 76 people. READ: […]...
